---
title: "Central Park Weather | 2006–2010"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: fill
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(p8105.datasets)

data("ny_noaa")

central_park =
  ny_noaa |>
  filter(
    id == "USW00094728",
    date >= as.Date("2006-01-01"),
    date < as.Date("2011-01-01")
  ) |>
  transmute(
    date,
    month = factor(
      format(date, "%m"),
      levels = sprintf("%02d", 1:12),
      labels = month.abb
    ),
    month_start = as.Date(format(date, "%Y-%m-01")),
    tmin_c = as.numeric(tmin) / 10,
    tmax_c = as.numeric(tmax) / 10,
    prcp_mm = prcp / 10
  )

monthly_precipitation =
  central_park |>
  group_by(month_start) |>
  summarise(
    observed_days = sum(!is.na(prcp_mm)),
    total_mm = sum(prcp_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(observed_days > 0)
```

Column {data-width=500}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------


### Daily minimum vs. maximum temperature

```{r temperature-scatter}
central_park |>
  filter(!is.na(tmin_c), !is.na(tmax_c)) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~tmin_c,
    y = ~tmax_c,
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "markers",
    text = ~format(date, "%b %d, %Y"),
    hovertemplate = "%{text}<br>Min %{x:.1f} °C<br>Max %{y:.1f} °C<extra></extra>",
    marker = list(color = "viridis", opacity = 0.55, size = 6)
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Daily minimum (°C)"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Daily maximum (°C)")
  )
```

Column {data-width=500}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Daily maximum temperature by calendar month

```{r temperature-box}
central_park |>
  filter(!is.na(tmax_c)) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~month,
    y = ~tmax_c,
    type = "box",
    marker = list(color = "viridis")
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Calendar month",
      categoryorder = "array",
      categoryarray = month.abb
    ),
    yaxis = list(title = "Daily maximum (°C)")
  )
```

### Monthly precipitation totals

```{r precipitation-bars}
monthly_precipitation |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~month_start,
    y = ~total_mm,
    type = "bar",
    text = ~paste(observed_days, "reporting days"),
    hovertemplate = "%{x|%b %Y}<br>%{y:.1f} mm<br>%{text}<extra></extra>",
    marker = list(color = "viridis")
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Month"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Total reported precipitation (mm)", rangemode = "tozero")
  )
```
